newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firm as cracker outage bolsters U.S..
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firm as cracker outage bolsters U.S..

text.p: NWE gasoline held firm on Tuesday afternoon with U.S. markets supported by a cat- cracker outage at Exxon's Baton Rouge refinery.
However, high freight costs continued to dampen transatlantic arbitrage activity despite some recent buying interest from North America, traders said.

"On paper the arbitrage is just about open and that has firmed the European market," one trader said. "But although there is some interest to put together cargoes, refinery blending differentials and freight costs are making it virtually unworkable," he added.
End-user buying in Europe stay thin with only trade buying supporting barges. Eurograde barges traded early at $221.25 and $222 but small afternoon gains saw trade even thinner.
